t: This is the Fourth Plinth in Trafalgar Square, which was the stage for One and Other, a public art project by Antony Gormley. Beginning at nine in the morning on the sixth of July, 2009, 2,400 members of the public each occupied the usually empty plinth for an hour, for 100 days, until the fourteenth of October. The first person up was Rachel Wardell from Lincolnshire. Gormley is the sculptor behind the Angel of the North. The Wellcome Trust has put its oral-history interviews with all 2,400 plinthers online.
